notes: Added missing core logic and integration depth stories to complete FEAT-3 coverage.

FEAT-3-S102.title: ClinicalTrials.gov Query Construction and Recruiting Filter Enforcement
FEAT-3-S102.description: Implement query builder logic in clinical_trials_service to construct ClinicalTrials.gov API requests with mandatory RECRUITING status filter and condition/location parameters.

FEAT-3-S103.title: Trial Location Extraction and Normalization
FEAT-3-S103.description: Parse ClinicalTrials.gov API responses to extract trial site locations and normalize them into structured address/location objects for downstream distance calculations.

FEAT-3-S104.title: Travel Distance and Duration Computation via Google Routes
FEAT-3-S104.description: Integrate Google Routes API within clinical_trials_service to compute travel distance and duration from user location to each trial site, including error handling for missing or invalid routes.

FEAT-3-S105.title: Clinical Trials Result Formatting and Ranking
FEAT-3-S105.description: Format enriched clinical trial results (metadata + distance + duration) and apply basic ranking (e.g., nearest first) before returning to facade layer.
